title: Powers of Corps members
question: What does FRSC Act 2007 section 19 say about powers of corps members?
shortAnswer: FRSC Act 2007 s.19 — Enter premises, stop vehicles, inspect documents, arrest offenders, impound vehicles, remove obstructions, tow vehicles, administer breath test, demand licence/documents, issue notices.
legalExplanation:
**Section 19 of the Federal Road Safety Commission (Establishment) Act, 2007** provides:

Enter premises, stop vehicles, inspect documents, arrest offenders, impound vehicles, remove obstructions, tow vehicles, administer breath test, demand licence/documents, issue notices

This Act established the FRSC with responsibility for road safety management, traffic regulation, driver licensing, vehicle inspection, and accident prevention on federal highways.
practicalOptions: Carry valid driver's licence, vehicle licence, proof of ownership, insurance. Obey speed limits and traffic signs. Do not drink and drive. Stop at checkpoints. Note officer details if fined.
whatToAvoid: Do not drive without licence, exceed speed limit, drink and drive, use forged documents, overload vehicle, bribe officers.
whatToDocument: Officer name, unit, vehicle plate, time, location, fine amount, receipt, photos of documents/vehicle.
whatToDoAfter: Pay fine at designated bank (not to officer). Keep receipt. Contest in court if wrong. Report misconduct to FRSC HQ or PCR Unit.
